claims.author: c33
claims.title: Phoretic colloids (SIMD), re-issued with its own labkit packs (seeds 0 and 2, t=800): the same Janus composites travel 4.5-6.4 body lengths with the B cap held and then divide into two capped composites; labkit generation 10 and 9, max 9.3-9.7 body lengths; the reciprocal twin neither travels nor divides

claims.author: c35
claims.title: Cooperative-catalysis CIPS condensates on a consumed fuel die within ~500 t when fuel regrowth stops (2/2 seeds) while their fed twins persist unchanged, but at a finer grid their rods and dumbbells are frozen (14 bodies, t=7000-15500): bodies that need their fuel, no division

claims.author: c34
claims.title: Trait swap in the two-kind Marangoni rods: whichever surfactant kind carries the Marangoni drive gains share over the neutral twin, on 6/6 paired comparisons (3 seeds x 2 assignments), with no kind conversions; the swimmers out-divide the non-swimmers

claims.author: c38
claims.title: Predators with heritable 20-bit matching genotypes keep producing adaptive new genotypes without saturating: late shadow-calibrated cohort novelty 11-21 vs 1-2 in the in-world neutral twin (6/6 seeds), 12-56 vs 0-1 in a shuffled-genotype twin (4/4 valid seeds), 84 vs 7 over 700k steps (~900 predator generations) with a linear cumulative curve; prey stay at the neutral rate, and against Rechtsteiner-Bedau shadows the predator excess is only marginal

claims.author: c40

claims.title: Condensate food chain: predators persist and cycle with their prey only on a mixed diet; restricting them after a fork to prey droplets alone or to dissolved prey alone kills them on 3/3 seeds each, while intact runs persist on 4/4 seeds (128^2) and 2/2 at 256^2

claims.author: c40
claims.title: C:metabolic-cell (SIBED): catalysis-induced condensates from a random field, each wrapped in a layer of an amphiphile it makes by its own catalysis, divide repeatedly by pinching on a consumed, regrowing fuel and all die within 100 t when fuel regrowth stops

claims.title: Slow fuel (Du 2 -> 0.3) in the chi=0 condensate food chain gives a standing, spatially segregated ecology: predators alive at t=12000 on 3/3 seeds (128^2) and t=10000 at 256^2, prey divide as dumbbells (persistent splits 14/8/3, 25 at 256^2) against 0/5/1 in the predator-free twin; predators coarsen and do not divide

claims.title: Reacting thermals (reactive-convection), SIMDE: burning caps formed from a random hot field rise on their own vortex pair into fresh fuel, travel 3+ body lengths between their own birth and their own fission (11/18, 6/9, 5/14 dividing caps on seeds 0-2), reach generation 5-8, and all go out within 2 t when the fuel is emptied; the g=0 reaction-diffusion twin divides but no dividing spot travels 3 lengths
